goal: Existing work that uses identifiability reasoning, metamorphic relations, or cross-channel consistency to decide whether a black-box authorization violation (BOLA/IDOR/BFLA) can be conclusively determined rather than only flagged as suspicious. Include work on differential testing of access control, metamorphic testing of REST APIs, the oracle problem in security testing, and formal decidability or impossibility arguments for vulnerability detection without policy ground truth.
